en_title: Sony Launches New PS Portal Model in Japan With Internal Storage for 'Future Functionality,' Changes Official Name
cn_title: 索尼在日本推出新版PS Portal，配备内部存储以支持「未来功能」，并更改正式名称
opus_summary: 索尼将在日本推出新版PlayStation Portal，新增内部存储以支持未来功能，具体细节将在确定后公布。新型号的日本正式名称去掉了「Remote」，将于12月10日发售，售价39,980日元(约合人民币1687元)，仅支持日语并需要日本PSN账号。

paragraphs.en: Sony is releasing a new model of the PlayStation Portal in Japan next month. The big difference is that it has internal storage, hinting that Sony might be expanding the handheld’s functions in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼将于下个月在日本推出新版PlayStation Portal。最大的区别在于它配备了内部存储，这暗示索尼未来可能会扩展这款掌机的功能。

paragraphs.en: “With an eye towards future functionality, the new model comes with the brand new addition of internal storage,” teased Sony Japan’s official blog post . “We will provide further details regarding these future features as they are finalized.”
paragraphs.cn: 索尼日本官方博客文章透露：「着眼于未来的功能，新机型全新加入了内部存储。有关这些未来功能的更多详情，我们将在敲定后公布。」

paragraphs.en: First released back in 2023 and looking like the stretch limo version of a PlayStation controller with an HD screen in the middle, the PlayStation Portal was originally designed as a way to play your PS5 games on handheld. Although this remote play function frees up your TV, it requires you to stream your games from your PS5 over Wi-fi.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation Portal于2023年首次推出，外形像是一只加长豪华轿车版的PlayStation控制器，中间配有一块高清屏幕。它最初旨在让玩家以掌机形式游玩PS5游戏。虽然这项远程游玩功能让电视得以空出来，但它需要通过Wi-Fi从PS5串流游戏。

paragraphs.en: In the official Playstation blog post announcing the new model, Sony emphasized that the Portal now allows “even players who don’t have a PS5” to enjoy PS5 games. Last year, Sony began giving PS Plus Premium members the option to stream games from the cloud to their PS Portal instead. With this new model release, Sony has also changed the full Japanese name of the handheld from “Playstation Portal Remote Player,” to simply “PlayStation Portal Player.” This suggests that the company is moving away from the Portal’s image as an accessory that streams from a PS5 console via Remote Play, to a more fully-fledged handheld.
paragraphs.cn: 在公布新机型的PlayStation官方博客文章中，索尼强调，Portal如今让「即使没有PS5的玩家」也能享受PS5游戏。去年，索尼开始让PS Plus Premium会员可以选择从云端向PS Portal串流游戏。随着新机型推出，索尼还将这款掌机在日本的全名从「Playstation Portal Remote Player」改为更简洁的「PlayStation Portal Player」。这表明索尼正让Portal摆脱通过Remote Play从PS5主机串流游戏的配件形象，转而成为一款功能更完整的掌机。

paragraphs.en: It’s also possible that any new functions added to the PS Portal could be a testing ground for the upcoming PS6, which has long been rumored to involve a handheld. Back in June, Sony Interactive Entertainment CEO Hideaki Nishino commented that developing new console experiences will involve “leveraging technologies that can be used in various forms and locations” and continuing to move the PlayStation brand beyond its common association of being played on a TV in the living room. More recently in October, there were rumors that Sony might have secured exclusive access to AMD’s next generation graphics tech for a new handheld.
paragraphs.cn: PS Portal新增的任何功能也可能成为即将推出的PS6的试验场，长期以来一直有传闻称PS6将涉及一款掌机。今年6月，索尼互动娱乐首席执行官西野秀明表示，开发新的主机体验将涉及「利用能够以各种形式、在各种场所使用的技术」，并继续推动PlayStation品牌超越人们通常认为它是在客厅电视上游玩的这种印象。最近在10月，又有传闻称索尼可能已获得AMD下一代图形技术的独家使用权，用于一款新掌机。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, the new PS Portal releases in Japan on December 10 and is up for preorder from November 13 at the same price as the current PS Portal (39,980yen). However, those interested in getting their hands on this model should note that it’s Japanese language only and requires a Japanese PSN account. It will be interesting to see if this new model makes it to other countries and regions.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，新版PS Portal将于12月10日在日本发售，11月13日起开放预订，价格与现款PS Portal相同，为39,980日元。不过，有意购买这款机型的人需要注意，它仅支持日语，并且需要日本PSN账号。新机型是否会登陆其他国家和地区，值得关注。

paragraphs.en: Verity Townsend is a Japan-based freelance writer who previously served as editor, contributor and translator for the game news site Automaton West. She has also written about Japanese culture and movies for various publications.
paragraphs.cn: Verity Townsend是一名常驻日本的自由撰稿人，曾在游戏新闻网站Automaton West担任编辑、撰稿人和翻译。她还曾为多家刊物撰写有关日本文化和电影的文章。
